description.value: Siam Thai Victoria is a Thai restaurant on Victoria's Fort Street offering a broad menu of classic and regional Thai dishes, from Pad Thai and curries to Isaan specialties like Som Tum and Crying Tiger Beef. Online ordering with a 15-minute pickup window makes it a practical and fast meal stop for cyclists moving through downtown. The menu includes a dedicated vegetarian section alongside seafood, chicken, beef, and pork options.
